name: contract-focused-audio-examples
goal: Project valid class audio into Examples with exact binding and original failure provenance without inventing screenshot coverage

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Core class tests retain WAV artifacts, but focusedCaptures discards every audio item. Permit sealed class audio with unit, case, revision and hash binding; keep images and original outcomes.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing source-identical screenshot case has no class audio or duplicate artifact slots. Haiku strengthened that case; primary adds colliding case/slot identities, invalid media and public in-memory image admission. No new test declarations.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Laptop record 33ba73a2ba24 at e370ec02e3 fails valid current class audio in the existing squash case. Public image getter/iterator/species admission still passes; no fixture error proves the defect.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Commit d26e0fdbea selects sealed class audio per case, slot and state, preserves original failure outcomes, and keeps audio separate from screenshot viewports.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Matched laptop record 3e43f1b4c5e6 passes the unchanged existing case after red 33ba73a2ba24, including forged bindings, case collisions and image admission controls.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
